sourceFile: 35. BRS-161016 Report test new bond G06-0003_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the bond change but has incorrect grouping and missing or invalid outcomes.
issues: Changed condition wrongly includes MG+Yoke; it is an outcome joint/subgroup, not the changed factor.
Function outcome mispairs round data and omits the second normal comparison row.
Tension test comparison is missing despite clear new vs normal rows.
Measurement outcome is a bad parse of function-table columns and should not stand as an outcome.
Change domain and subgroup keys are overbroad or incomplete.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to normal bond G06-0002 vs new/test bond G06-0003 only.
Treat MG+PT, MG+Yoke, test round, and outcome type as subgroup/context keys where supported.
Rebuild function results as round-matched pairs, including the second normal row.
Add tension test outcome using rows 41 and 42 with strength summary and judgement.
Remove the spurious measurement outcome and tighten evidence rows to cited comparison rows plus title/purpose.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations prove row existence but are overbroad and not sufficient for final evidence until corrected.
